summary: Machined aluminium L-bracket: base leg bolted to a flat plate with four M6 bolts, upright leg carries a 2 kg sensor box. The sensor-box interface (fastener size and hole pattern) is not specified and defines the upright geometry, so it must be asked.

requirements.text: Mount a sensor box to a flat plate: base leg on the plate, sensor box on the upright leg.
Supported payload: sensor box mass 2 kg.
Bracket fixed to the plate with four M6 bolts.
Parametric, editable Fusion model with named parameters and features.

missing_information.why_it_matters: Fastener size, count and hole pattern of the sensor box define the upright leg holes, its minimum width/height and the interface. A wrong guess makes the bracket unusable.
missing_information.question: How is the sensor box fastened to the bracket upright: fastener size, number of fasteners and hole pattern (e.g. 4 x M5 on a 36 mm (width) x 28 mm (height) rectangle), and roughly how far is the box's centre of mass from its mounting face?

missing_information.why_it_matters: Yield strength used in the hand calculation.
A 2 kg static mass says nothing about vibration or shock; sizing needs a design load.

missing_information.topic: Hole pattern in the flat plate
missing_information.why_it_matters: If the plate is pre-drilled the base holes must match it.

assumptions.text: Concept-level design: nominal geometry, no tolerancing, no FEA/fatigue analysis; sizing by hand calculation only.
assumptions.impact: Results are not a structural sign-off.

assumptions.rationale: Most common general-purpose machining alloy; user said 'aluminium' only.
assumptions.impact: Yield strength 276 MPa (handbook, not verified) used in the bending check.

assumptions.text: Design load = 2 kg x 5 g = 98.1 N acting perpendicular to the upright mounting face's offset (worst-case bending of the upright), required safety factor on yield 2.0.
assumptions.rationale: No environment given; 5 g covers handling, shock and vibration typical of vehicle-mounted equipment at concept level.
assumptions.impact: Drives plate thickness; must be confirmed for the real environment.

assumptions.text: No hard envelope limit; keep the bracket compact (each leg < 100 mm, width <= 70 mm).
assumptions.impact: Leg lengths/width chosen from hole layout and edge-distance rules only.

assumptions.text: The flat plate will be drilled to match the bracket; base holes in a 2 x 2 rectangular pattern with ISO 273 medium clearance (6.6 mm).
assumptions.impact: Base hole pattern is defined by the bracket and must be transferred to the plate.
